items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: I saw Bill Evans every year. He came every year for two days. I never missed any of the shows.

ctx.x: I saw Bill Evans every year. He came every year for two days. I never missed any of the shows. I would sit there and pay them again to see the second show. And most of the time he’d play different music anyway. Oh it was remarkable. You know Rochester was — I’d go to the Pythod.
The Pythod. You know I’m from Rochester.
